messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Losartan is used alone or in combination with other medications to treat high blood pressure in adults and children at least 6 years old.
Losartan is also used to decrease the risk of stroke.
This use applies to people who have high blood pressure.
It also applies to people with a heart condition called left ventricular hypertrophy.
Left ventricular hypertrophy is the enlargement of the walls of the left side of the heart.
Losartan may not decrease the risk of stroke in African Americans who have these conditions.
Losartan is also used to treat kidney disease.
This treatment is for people who have type 2 diabetes.
Type 2 diabetes is a condition in which the body does not use insulin normally.
Consequently, the body cannot control the amount of sugar in the blood.
Losartan is also used to treat high blood pressure.
Losartan belongs to a class of medications called angiotensin II receptor antagonists.
Losartan works by blocking the action of certain natural substances.
These substances tighten the blood vessels.
Blocking them allows the blood to flow more smoothly.
Triplet: ["Certain natural substances", "tighten", "blood vessels"]

The relation 'tighten' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject substance or entity causes the object entity to become tighter or constricted.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'vary by': The subject entity differs depending on the object entity.
B. 'can occur when': The condition specified by the subject entity may arise under the circumstances described by the object entity.
C. 'has dose limitation': The subject drug has a restriction on the dose specified by the object entity.
D. 'reduced absorption by': The absorption of the subject drug is decreased due to the presence of the substance specified by the object entity.
E. 'can cause': The subject entity may lead to or result in the condition or effect specified by the object entity.

Answer:
